“韦导，汪编，路上小心。”

望着远远驶离的汽车，魏沐挥了挥手。

饭店门外，时间已近傍晚，夕阳微斜，晕黄色的阳光照亮陈贺那生无可恋的方圆脸。

“走了。”

他拍了拍好兄弟的肩膀：“我们回去吧。”

走了几步，发现身后没反应，魏沐疑惑的转过身。

“老陈，还不走？”

陈贺表情古怪，他慢慢来到对方面前，就要纳头便拜。

“哎哎哎，为何，为何要行如此大礼啊。”

赶紧伸手拦住。

男大宿舍流传着一种说法，每个人都想做对方爸爸。

他也想。

但想归想，陈贺真要这么喊，肯定不能答应。

凭空多出一个大儿子，谁愿意？以后还要给红包钱！！

“老魏，我今天是服了，你真牛逼。”

陈贺不知道该怎么用语言形容刚才饭店的那一幕幕。

太夸张，太假，说给郑凯杜姜听，那两人都觉得他在吹牛逼。

“以后我就跟着你混了，你让我干什么，我就干什么！！”

有这么牛逼的大腿，一定要好好抱住。

他这次赌对了！！

导演那边不管是花钱买歌，还是用网络版权换，他这个男主角十拿九稳。

“我让你好好和许静谈恋爱结婚，你能做到吗？”

“这不是废话，我和静静本来就要结婚。”

他现在女朋友叫许静，两人从初中开始谈恋爱，一直到现在。

身边几个舍友都见过她，妥妥的嫂子。

呵呵...

魏沐没有多说。

现在是现在，以后是以后。

在这个圈子，人红了什么乱七八糟东西都会围上来，那个时候说的话才算数。

不过魏沐也不会要求他什么，毕竟自己就不是什么好鸟。

“你怎么突然提起这个？”

“没什么，随便说说。”

接下来几天，魏沐把《爱的回归线》曲子弄完，然后又写了一首《虹之间》

《虹之间》是《爱情公寓4》的插曲，在后世配合着“子乔与美嘉病床对话”的催泪场景出圈，并创下1500万点击量记录。

《爱情公寓》三大神曲，除了主题曲《我的未来式》，其他两首歌都给他写出来。

有了这两首歌，相信汪远那边可以做出正确选择。

搞定《爱情公寓》歌曲，接下来该忙着与宋柯约定。

两人之前约定五首歌，如今已经写出来四首。

"Director Wei, Editor Wang, be careful on the road."

Looking at the car driving away in the distance, Wei Mu waved his hand.

Outside the hotel door, it was almost evening, the setting sun was slightly slanting, and the hazy yellow sunlight illuminated Chen He's loveless square face.

"Gone."

He patted his good brother on the shoulder: "Let's go back."

After walking a few steps and finding no response from behind, Wei Mu turned around in confusion.

"Old Chen, aren't you leaving yet?"

Chen He had a strange expression. He slowly came to the other party and bowed before him.

"Hey, hey, why, why do you have to pay such a big courtesy?"

Quickly reach out your hand to stop him.

There is a saying circulating in the boys' dormitory that everyone wants to be each other's dad.

He wanted to too.

But thinking about it, if Chen He really wanted to shout like that, he definitely couldn't agree.

Who would want an eldest son born out of thin air?I will give red envelope money in the future!!

"Old Wei, I'm convinced today, you are so awesome."

Chen He didn't know how to use words to describe the scene in the hotel just now.

It was too exaggerated and too fake. If he told Zheng Kai and Du Jiang, they both thought he was bragging.

"I will follow you from now on, and I will do whatever you ask me to do!!"

With such awesome thighs, you must hold them tightly.

He made the right bet this time!!

Whether the director spends money to buy songs or exchanges for Internet copyrights, he is a sure winner as the leading actor.

"I asked you to fall in love and get married with Xu Jing, can you do it?"

"This is not nonsense, Jingjing and I were going to get married."

His current girlfriend's name is Xu Jing, and they have been dating since junior high school until now.

Several roommates around me have seen her, she is a perfect sister-in-law.

Haha...

Wei Mu didn't say much.

Now is now, and then is later.

In this circle, people will gather around you if you are famous or anything else. At that time, your words will count.

But Wei Mu wouldn't ask him for anything, after all, he was not a good bird.

"Why did you suddenly mention this?"

"Nothing, just talk."

In the next few days, Wei Mu finished the song "Line of Return of Love" and then wrote another song "Between the Rainbows"

"Between the Rainbows" is an episode of "Love Apartment 4". It was later released with the tear-jerking scene of "Zi Qiao and Mei Jia's hospital bed conversation" and set a record of 15 million views.

In addition to the theme song "My Future Tense", the other two songs of "Love Apartment" were all written for him.

With these two songs, I believe Wang Yuan can make the right choice.

After finishing the song "Love Apartment", it's time to get busy making an appointment with Song Ke.

The two had agreed on five songs before, but now they have written four.
